origin.match: Match each martial art to the country it comes from.
origin.odd: Three of these martial arts come from {value}. Which one doesn't?

exclude.why: Krav Maga: its origin is contested (Czechoslovakia by Wikidata, Israel by most players)

rows.label: Krav Maga
rows.hook: was developed for hand-to-hand combat training in the Israeli military

rows.label: Brazilian jiu-jitsu
rows.hook: focuses on ground fighting and submission holds, and became central to mixed martial arts

rows.label: Muay Thai
rows.description: combat sport and martial art that uses stand-up striking along with various clinching techniques
rows.hook: is known as the art of eight limbs for its use of fists, elbows, knees and shins in striking

rows.label: taekwondo
rows.hook: is known for its fast, high kicks and is an Olympic sport

rows.label: jujutsu
rows.hook: teaches throws, joint locks and pins that turn an opponent's own force against them

rows.label: judo
rows.description: modern martial art, combat and Olympic/Paralympic sport
rows.hook: is an Olympic sport where a single perfect throw or pin can end a match instantly

rows.label: karate
rows.hook: is famous for powerful punches and kicks, and for competitors breaking boards with a single strike

rows.label: sumo
rows.hook: pits two large wrestlers against each other, each trying to force the other out of a circular ring

rows.label: sambo
rows.description: martial art sport developed in the USSR
rows.hook: blends wrestling and jacket grappling, and was originally developed to train soldiers in hand-to-hand combat

rows.label: aikido
rows.description: Japanese martial art developed by Morihei Ueshiba
rows.hook: redirects an attacker's momentum through circular, blending movements rather than striking back

rows.label: Jeet Kune Do
rows.hook: was created by Bruce Lee around the idea that a fighter should adapt freely instead of one fixed style

rows.label: Chinese martial arts
rows.description: variety of fighting styles developed in China
rows.hook: is showcased worldwide through kung fu films and Shaolin monks demonstrating gravity-defying stunts

rows.label: kendo
rows.hook: uses bamboo swords and protective armour in duels inspired by samurai swordsmanship

rows.label: Kalaripayattu
rows.hook: is considered one of the world's oldest fighting systems, blending strikes, weapons and healing massage

rows.label: pencak silat
rows.hook: combines flowing, dance-like movements with strikes, and is sometimes performed to live music at festivals

rows.label: pankration
rows.description: martial art in ancient Greek festivals
rows.hook: combined boxing and wrestling with almost no rules, and was a brutal event at the original Olympic Games

rows.label: hapkido
rows.hook: blends joint locks and throws with powerful kicks, drawing on both grappling and striking traditions
